verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's docs say customers can be screened against a global database that includes Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) registers, so PEP identification is a documented capability. Nothing in the pack covers related associates (RCAs) or the source context attached to PEP hits. The only coverage is a single overview mention. Missing for 10: documented detection of PEP relatives and close associates, supporting source context or provenance on PEP matches, PEP classification or tier detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
